title: Recovery Distribution Terms for Legal Forwarding Agreements
content:
Under the Legal Forwarding Agreements, three programme terms decide where money recovered on a forwarded matter goes beyond the debt itself: the order in which recoveries from the debtor are applied, whether post-judgment interest collected is passed to the creditor client, and what share of court-awarded attorney fees the attorney keeps.

## Terms by programme

| Programme | Application of debtor recoveries | Post-judgment interest passed to the client | Attorney's share of court-awarded attorney fees |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | Costs first | No | 0.0% |
| Small Claims Suit Program | Costs first | Yes | 100.0% |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Costs first | Yes | 100.0% |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Costs first | Yes | 100.0% |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | Costs first | Yes | 100.0% |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | Pro rata | Yes | 50.0% |

## What each term means

**Application of debtor recoveries.** This term names how recoveries from the debtor are applied on the programme, as one of two settings: costs first, or pro rata. Five programmes use costs first; the Full-Service Litigation Program is the only programme set to pro rata.

**Post-judgment interest.** This term states whether post-judgment interest collected is passed to the client. It is passed to the client under every programme except the Attorney Demand Program, which shows No.

**Court-awarded attorney fees.** This term is the share of court-awarded attorney fees kept by the attorney, in percent; the rest goes to the client. Where the attorney's share is 100.0%, nothing of the award goes to the client; where it is 50.0%, the attorney and the client each receive half.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

The award below is an invented amount used only to show how the share reads.

| Programme | Hypothetical court-awarded attorney fees | Kept by the attorney | Goes to the client |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Litigation Program | $600.00 | 50.0 percent, $300.00 | the rest, $300.00 |
| Small Claims Suit Program | $600.00 | 100.0 percent, $600.00 | the rest, $0.00 |

## Points of reading

- Is post-judgment interest kept by Ridgeline under the Judgment Enforcement Program? No — that programme shows Yes for passing post-judgment interest collected to the client.
- Which programme splits court-awarded attorney fees between the attorney and the client? The Full-Service Litigation Program, at 50.0 percent kept by the attorney.
